name: Luciq (formerly Instabug) Android SDK

dataTypes.when: By default. User steps (taps, double taps, long presses, swipes, scrolls, pinches; up to 100 per report) are attached to reports. Disable with Luciq.setTrackingUserStepsState(Feature.State.DISABLED).

By default. Console logs (up to 1,000 statements) attached to reports; disable with setConsoleLogState(DISABLED). Reports also include device model, OS/app version, screen info, locale and a session profile (memory, battery).

dataTypes.type: App info and performance / Crash logs
dataTypes.when: If crash reporting is used: each crash occurrence carries device info, user attributes, user steps, network and console logs.
With crash reporting: Luciq lists 'Device location' in every crash occurrence. The SDK requests no location permission, so this is treated as IP-derived approximate location.

ask: Do you use bug reporting / feedback? Users can submit their email, a message, screenshots, screen recordings and voice notes (the SDK declares RECORD_AUDIO). Declare Personal info / Email address, Messages / Other in-app messages, Photos and videos / Photos, Photos and videos / Videos and Audio files / Voice or sound recordings as applicable, or remove unused permissions/features.

Do you log network requests (Unified Network Interception, OkHttp interceptor or LuciqNetworkLog)? Request/response bodies and headers are attached; mask sensitive fields or declare what they contain.
Do you set user identity or attributes (identifyUser with email/name/ID, user attributes, custom data)? Declare Personal info / Email address, Name, User IDs accordingly.
Repro steps can include screenshots of screens; have you marked private views / enabled auto-masking? If not, screens showing personal data are collected.
Do you use chats or surveys? Declare Messages / Other in-app messages and App activity / Other user-generated content.

sources.title: Report Logs for Android - Luciq Docs
Integrate Luciq on Android - Luciq Docs

notes: Instabug rebranded to Luciq: current Maven group is ai.luciq.library (artifact luciq); legacy is com.instabug.library:instabug (and instabug-* modules). No Luciq/Instabug Google Play Data safety guide was found; mapping inferred from SDK docs and needs review. Luciq recommends mentioning in your privacy policy that logging data may be collected to troubleshoot bugs. Approximate location is declared because Luciq's crash occurrence page lists 'Device location'; confirm with Luciq if you need precision. Reviewed 2026-11-13 against the cited pages.
